module: "Static Object Touch" node (category `repeat_instant`, tags collision/static). Detects an intersection of the vehicle with static objects or the terrain, using rays (`castRayStatic`) cast from the center toward 8 offset points (FL, F, FR, R, BR, B, BL, L) of the OOBB. Input pins: `vehId`, `widthOffset`, `lengthOffset`, `heightOffset` (default 0.5), `debugMode`. Outputs: `touching`, flow `touchFL/F/FR/R/BR/B/BL/L` (hidden), `isTouching`.
notes: No input flow and no `flow` output: only the touch outputs.
Debug: red (touched) or green spheres drawn in `onPreRender`.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStarted.desc: Creates the 8 points and the working vectors.

_executionStopped.desc: Frees the points and resets the outputs.

onPreRender.desc: Render hook: draws the debug spheres if `debugMode` is active.

reset.desc: Sets all outputs to false and disables the node.

work.desc: Computes the 8 points, casts the rays and fills the outputs.
